newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's 8-mth trade deficit falls 20.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's 8-mth trade deficit falls 20.9 pct.

text.p: Sri Lanka's trade deficit in the first eight months of this year fell 20.9 percent to $836 million from $1,057 million a year earlier, the Central Bank said on Friday.
Exports rose to $2.63 billion in the eight months from $2.44 billion a year earlier, while imports fell to $3.47 billion from $3.50 billion, the bank said.
Industrial exports rose slightly to $1.93 billion in the January-August period from $1.84 billion a year ago, it said.
